operations.title: The physical shared-wall boundary is a closed three-component Cech cocycle with zero mixed occurrence component
operations.statement: All pairwise iterated shared-wall residues cancel by oriented Jacobians, while the source occurrence numerator vanishes on the mixed occurrence intersection. Thus rho_phys=(rho1,rho2,rho3;0) lies in the kernel of the pair-incidence differential.

operations.title: Exact pair-incidence closure gate for the physical G12 residue
operations.method: Evaluate all three shared-wall pairs at generic exact kinematics, verify legal denominators and opposite oriented Jacobians, and separately evaluate the mixed occurrence numerator.
